courses.title: Computer Architecture
searches: FIU "CDA 3102" computer architecture syllabus 2025 ChatGPT AI
courses.note: The major requires no algorithms course (COP 4534 Algorithm Techniques is only a Foundations elective), so C3 falls back to a required systems course. Required systems courses are CDA 3102, COP 4338 and COP 4610; CDA 3102 (computer organization) was chosen as the first listed. Newest readable syllabus is dated 9/23/2019 (Internet Archive copy). Search results show a 2026 revised syllabus (users.cs.fiu.edu/~prabakar/upc/flowcharts/2026-08/New_Syllabi/Revised_Pat_Courses/CDA_3102.pdf) whose snippet mentions AI-guided code translation and debugging as course content, but the host was unreachable and no archive copy existed, so it was not read.

notes: Program per FIU catalog: BS Computer Science, Computer Science track (Fall 2023 flowchart, Fall 2025 version). The catalog page strips course numbers, so the frame courses come from the CEC flowchart PDF (cec.fiu.edu), which lists COP 2210, COP 3337, COP 3530, CDA 3102, COP 4338, COP 4610, CEN 4010, CIS 3950, CIS 4951. All four statuses are 'outdated' because the only readable syllabi are the school's generic program syllabi from 2018-2020. These come from the school's syllabus pages, not term-specific section syllabi. Newer 2025-26 curriculum-committee syllabi (users.cs.fiu.edu/~prabakar/ugc/2025-26/...) exist for at least COP 2210, COP 3337 and CDA 3102 but FIU CS hosts were unreachable (connection timeouts and refusals) during collection. A re-try from another network could upgrade C1-C3 and might reveal AI statements. Text for these syllabi was read via web.archive.org copies of the www4.cis.fiu.edu URLs.
